hourly.note: ts_utc is the candle end_period_ts; price forward-filled for hours with no trades

hourly_grid.note: every hour of the window; ts_utc is the hour's end (bucket start + 1 h), the same convention as the Kalshi candles. Null = no data for that hour.

daily.note: Kalshi daily: volume = sum of hourly candles by UTC date of end_period_ts, close = last close of the day. Hourly attention and trade series are summed by UTC date of the bucket start (null if any hour is missing); small_trade_share is small trades / all trades for the day. Attention values are never interpolated.
